claim: ICBINB @ ICLR 2025 ('Challenges in Applied Deep Learning') was held in-person April 28 2025 at Hall 4 #1, Singapore EXPO, co-located with ICLR 2025, and used framing nearly identical to the 2026 edition about publication mechanisms failing to systematically collect real-world failure cases.
stance_target: establishing the immediate precedent edition confirming ICBINB's move from NeurIPS to ICLR
quoted_support: Current publication mechanisms tend to prioritize solutions that work on standard bench, lacking a platform to systematically collect real-world failure cases.
